model.name: R20.7: Room drawer = consistent with /trace drawer + CHAT default when no selection.
model.description: STRUCTURAL (reframed): the room drawer MUST behave IDENTICALLY to the (now-correct) /trace traceability-browser drawer — same structure, same selection→detail behavior, same tap-to-switch, same overlay position. CONSISTENCY, not a separate/different implementation. PLUS: when NO item is selected in a room, the drawer shows the CHAT panel as default content (per R20.6b). When an item is selected → detail view (identical to /trace). /trace drawer stays unchanged (already correct). Room drawer = /trace drawer + chat-default. Supersedes the prior "separate overlay" framing — it is NOT a different overlay, it IS the /trace drawer reused with one behavioral addition (empty selection → chat).
model.tronQuote:
> TRON (original): "the drawer is structurally wrong. its part of the room page and not on top of the overviews page"
> TRON (reframe): room drawer = SAME as /trace drawer (consistency) + switch to CHAT when no item selected. NOT a separate overlay — identical to the correct /trace behavior.
model.crossRefNote: BUG5 (detail switch broken) + BUG4 (deselect closes) were symptoms of the structural error (drawer embedded in room page). R20.7 fixes the structure: overlay on top. Prior split approach is reverted.

intendedChain.useCase: drawer.roomConsistentWithTrace — room drawer = /trace drawer behavior + chat-default on empty selection
intendedChain.test: RED: (1) room drawer position/structure matches /trace drawer (same CSS, same overlay behavior). (2) no selection in room → drawer shows chat. (3) select item → drawer shows detail (same as /trace). (4) /trace unchanged/still works.
